architecture.name: IRIS_TWO_STATE_CROSSFIT_STACK_V1
architecture.principle: Represent one explicit causal state transition per specialist; keep the successful cross-fitted evidence fusion unchanged.

state_features.previous: nearest aggregate vector ending 24 hours earlier, tolerance +/-3 hours, strictly earlier only
state_features.delta: current minus previous for features finite in both states
state_features.missing_lag: leave previous/delta as NaN for XGBoost native missing handling; do not impute a synthetic state

architecture.expert_model: same frozen five-seed XGBoost recipe as static specialists
architecture.inner_crossfit: same four expanding outer-fit folds as IRIS_CROSSFIT_EVIDENCE_STACK_V1
architecture.meta_model: same PositiveEvidenceStack equation and hyperparameters as IRIS_CROSSFIT_EVIDENCE_STACK_V1
architecture.calibration: one logit intercept on calibration role only
architecture.threshold: MAX_TSS and POD80_MIN_FAR on threshold role only

why_this_is_bounded: Exactly one temporal lag and one deterministic delta

paired_bootstrap.unit: complete SEP episode / predeclared quiet block

promotion_rule: Promote two-state specialists only if operational POD80_MIN_FAR TSS is not materially worse on the older score block, improves the 2023-2025 monitor point estimate, and does not materially degrade Brier/ECE or matched-detection FAR. Otherwise retain the static cross-fitted stack and stop architecture expansion until richer verified observations exist.
claim_rule: All score/monitor evidence is already-inspected development evidence. No external or final superiority claim is permitted from this diagnostic.
